landing.whyTitle: Built for small repairs that still need a real crew.
landing.why1Body: Match contractors and stores to the actual job site — not a generic city-wide listing.
landing.why2Body: Photos, video of the leak, and a structured quotation live in the same thread.
landing.why3Body: Labor, materials, and transport are itemized before you confirm. No surprise extras.
landing.why4Body: Portfolios, certificates, and reviews sit on a profile — not a Facebook comment.
landing.howTitle: Four steps. No group chat chaos.
landing.how1Body: Drop a pin or allow GPS. We search crews and stores around that coordinate.
landing.how2Body: Category, photos, a short note. Contractors see the site before they quote.
landing.how3Body: Itemized labor, materials, transport, and estimated time — accept or request a tweak.
landing.how4Body: Materials on the way, progress photos, then you confirm completion.
landing.footerBlurb: A local operating system for residential repair — homeowners, contractors, and stores on one workflow.
